'''Alfred Leipertz''' is a [[physicist]], engineer, and academian. He is an emeritus chair professor of Engineering [[Thermodynamic]]s and senior professor of [[Chemical Engineering]] at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg|Friedrich-Alexander University of Erlangen-Nuremberg]] (FAU). Leipertz co-founded the Erlangen Graduate School in Advanced Optical Technologies (SAOT) at FAU, established under the Excellence Initiative of the [[Federal Government of Germany|German Federal]] and State Governments. He has also served as director emeritus and [[ambassador]] of SAOT.

Leipertz is a fellow of the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] (IUPAC), [[Optica (society)|Optica]], and [[The Combustion Institute]]. He is also a recipient of the Yeram S. Touloukian Award from the [[American Society of Mechanical Engineers]] (ASME).

==Education==
From 1968 to 1974, Leipertz studied mathematics, chemistry, and physics at the [[University of Giessen|Justus Liebig University Giessen]]. He earned his [[Doctor of Engineering]] degree from [[Ruhr University Bochum]] in 1979, followed by his [[Habilitation]] (Venia Legendi) in Heat and Mass Transfer in 1984.<ref name=CV>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ltt.tf.fau.eu/files/2019/07/CV-Leipertz-englisch-neues-Bild-10-2025.pdf|title=Prof. Dr.-Ing. Dr. h.c. Alfred Leipertz|website=ltt.tf.fau.eu|access-date=October 30, 2025}}</ref>

==Career==
In 1974, Leipertz began his career as a physicist at the [[German Aerospace Center]]. From 1975 to 1976, he worked as a research assistant in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the [[University of Duisburg|Duisburg University]]. Between 1977 and 1984, he served as a research assistant and assistant professor at the [[Ruhr University Bochum|Ruhr University]]. From 1984 to 1986, Leipertz continued teaching at Ruhr University as a ''[[Privatdozent]]''. He later held two appointments there: tenured associate professor of Experimental Heat and Mass Transfer from 1986 to 1988, and full professor of Laser Techniques from 1988 to 1989. Subsequently, he joined the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg|Friedrich-Alexander University of Erlangen-Nuremberg]] (FAU) as chair professor of Engineering Thermodynamics, a position he held until his retirement in 2014. Since then, he has held the title of emeritus chair professor.<ref name=CV/>

Leipertz co-founded the Erlangen Graduate School in ''Advanced Optical Technologies'' (SAOT) at FAU as part of the German Excellence Initiative, serving as its director until 2014. Since then, he has held the titles of ambassador and director emeritus of SAOT.<ref name=CV/>

During his academic career, Leipertz has authored [[patent]]s<ref name=CV/> and published research papers that have collectively received over 16,500 citations, with an h-index of 66.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=pwIq95kAAAAJ&hl|title=Alfred Leipertz|website=Google Scholar|access-date=September 3, 2025}}</ref> He is also the author of textbooks, including ''Engineering Thermodynamics for Mechanical Engineers, Production Engineers, and Chemical and Bioengineers'',<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://search.worldcat.org/title/775134089|title=Engineering thermodynamics for mechanical engineers, production engineers, and chemical and bioengineers|website=WorldCat|access-date=September 2, 2025}}</ref> ''Wärme- und Stoffübertragung'',<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://search.worldcat.org/title/281235757?oclcNum=281235757|title=Wärme- und Stoffübertragung für Studierende der Fachrichtungen Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemie- und Bioingenieurwesen, Life-Science-Engineering|website=WorldCat|access-date=September 2, 2025}}</ref> and ''Einführung in die Verbrennungstechnik''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://search.worldcat.org/title/806989403|title=Einführung in die Verbrennungstechnik|website=WorldCat|access-date=September 2, 2025}}</ref> He additionally holds the title of emeritus member of the International Association for Transport Properties (IATP).<ref name=CV/>

Outside academia, Leipertz established the ESYTEC Energie- und Systemtechnik GmbH company, which he managed as technical director and chief executive officer (CEO).<ref name=CV/>

==Research==
Leipertz's research interests have focused on engineering thermodynamics and adjacent areas, including [[condensation]] dependability on surface wettability,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Manfred |first1=Linke |last2=Ulrike |first2=Praeger |last3=A. |first3=Neuwald, Daniel |last4=Martin |first4=Geyer |title=Measurement of Water Vapor Condensation on Apple Surfaces during Controlled Atmosphere Storage |journal=Sensors |date=2023 |volume=23 |issue=3 |page=1739 |doi=10.3390/s23031739 |pmid=36772778 |pmc=9920950 |bibcode=2023Senso..23.1739L |doi-access=free |language=en }}</ref> [[laser-induced fluorescence]] (LIF) spectroscopy,<ref>{{cite book |last1=Kearney |first1=Sean P. |last2=Grasser |first2=Thomas W. |title=Volume 6: Energy Systems: Analysis, Thermodynamics and Sustainability |chapter=CARS Probing of Meter-Scale Turbulent Pool Fires |date=2009 |pages=427–430 |doi=10.1115/IMECE2007-42254 |url=https://asmedigitalcollection.asme.org/IMECE/proceedings-abstract/IMECE2007/43009/427/325877 |publisher=American Society of Mechanical Engineers Digital Collection |isbn=978-0-7918-4300-0 |language=en|url-access=subscription }}</ref> light scattering analysis,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Reverchon |first1=Ernesto |last2=De Marco |first2=Iolanda |title=Mechanisms controlling supercritical antisolvent precipitate morphology |journal=Chemical Engineering Journal |date=2011 |volume=169 |issue=1 |pages=358–370 |doi=10.1016/j.cej.2011.02.064 |bibcode=2011ChEnJ.169..358R |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1385894711002737#:~:text=In%20this%20work%2C%20the%20interactions,for%20the%20observed%20SAS%20morphologies.|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and [[Raman scattering|Raman]] and [[Rayleigh scattering]] techniques.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Dancová |first1=Petra |last2=Psota |first2=Pavel |last3=Vít |first3=Tomáš |title=Limits of Digital Holographic Interferometry used for Measurement of Temperature Fields |journal=International Journal of Applied Physics |date=2018 |volume=03 |url=https://www.iaras.org/home/caijap/limits-of-digital-holographic-interferometry-used-for-measurement-of-temperature-fields |language=en}}</ref> He also worked on photon correlation spectroscopy,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bertrand |first1=C. E. |last2=Self |first2=J. L. |last3=Copley |first3=J. R. D. |last4=Faraone |first4=A. |title=Dynamic signature of molecular association in methanol |journal=The Journal of Chemical Physics |date=2016 |volume=145 |issue=1 |pages=014502 |doi=10.1063/1.4954964 |pmid=27394112 |bibcode=2016JChPh.145a4502B }}</ref> investigated [[ionic liquid]]s,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Tiwari |first1=Naveen |last2=Ho |first2=Fanny |last3=Krisnadi |first3=Febby |last4=Kulkarni |first4=Mohit Rameshchandra |last5=Nguyen |first5=Linh Lan |last6=Koh |first6=Soo Jin Adrian |last7=Mathews |first7=Nripan |title=High-k, Ultrastretchable Self-Enclosed Ionic Liquid-Elastomer Composites for Soft Robotics and Flexible Electronics |journal=ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces |date=2020 |volume=12 |issue=33 |pages=37561–37570 |doi=10.1021/acsami.0c08754 |pmid=32814378 |bibcode=2020AAMI...1237561A |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsami.0c08754|url-access=subscription |doi-access=free }}</ref> and predicted ionic liquids' thermal conductivity.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hezave |first1=Ali Zeinolabedini |last2=Raeissi |first2=Sona |last3=Lashkarbolooki |first3=Mostafa |title=Estimation of Thermal Conductivity of Ionic Liquids Using a Perceptron Neural Network |journal=Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research |date=2012 |volume=51 |issue=29 |pages=9886–9893 |doi=10.1021/ie202681b |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/ie202681b|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

To achieve [[dropwise condensation]] (DWC), Leipertz formed amorphous layers of hydrogenated [[Diamond-like carbon|Diamond-Like Carbon]] on a flat copper surface and discovered that DWC has an 11-fold higher heat transfer coefficient than filmwise condensation (FWC).<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Alwazzan |first1=Mohammad |title=Enhanced Dropwise Condensation Via Wettability Contrast Mechanism |journal=Theses and Dissertations |date=2017 |url=https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/etd/4487/#:~:text=Such%20mechanism%20can%20be%20achieved,contrast%20degree%20of%20these%20regions.}}</ref> He also examined the impact of DWC on water production costs, concluding that increasing heat transfer coefficients reduces the temperature difference between the [[evaporator]] and [[Condenser (heat transfer)|condenser]], lowering compressor work requirements.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Mistry |first1=Karan H. |last2=McGovern |first2=Ronan K. |last3=Thiel |first3=Gregory P. |last4=Summers |first4=Edward K. |last5=Zubair |first5=Syed M. |last6=Lienhard |first6=John H. |title=Entropy Generation Analysis of Desalination Technologies |journal=Entropy |date=2011 |volume=13 |issue=10 |pages=1829–1864 |doi=10.3390/e13101829 |doi-access=free |bibcode=2011Entrp..13.1829M |language=en|hdl=1721.1/69217 |hdl-access=free }}</ref> Additionally, he studied uncoated and coated horizontal plain, high-performance, and standard finned tubes to determine the condensing heat transfer coefficients of R134a and R290.<ref name=research>{{cite journal |last1=Ji |first1=Wen-Tao |last2=Mao |first2=Shuai-Feng |last3=Chong |first3=Guo-Hun |last4=Zhao |first4=Chuang-Yao |last5=Zhang |first5=Hu |last6=Tao |first6=Wen-Quan |title=Numerical and experimental investigation on the condensing heat transfer of R134a outside plain and integral-fin tubes |journal=Applied Thermal Engineering |date=2019 |volume=159 |article-number=113878 |doi=10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2019.113878 |bibcode=2019AppTE.15913878J |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1359431118367991|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

Together with Al-Badri and others, Leipertz employed an analytical model to estimate the condensing heat transfer coefficient.<ref name=research/> However, he also highlighted other analytical approaches, including jet impingement boiling for heat transfer.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Jha |first1=Jay M. |last2=Ravikumar |first2=Satya V. |last3=Sarkar |first3=Ishita |last4=Pal |first4=Surjya K. |last5=Chakraborty |first5=Sudipto |title=Jet Impingement Cooling of a Hot Moving Steel Plate: An Experimental Study |journal=Experimental Heat Transfer |date=2016 |volume=29 |issue=5 |pages=615–631 |doi=10.1080/08916152.2015.1046019 |bibcode=2016ExHT...29..615J |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/08916152.2015.1046019 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> In combustion research, he focused on the structure of methane-air flames,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Tamadonfar |first1=Parsa |last2=Gülder |first2=Ömer L. |title=Experimental investigation of the inner structure of premixed turbulent methane/air flames in the thin reaction zones regime |journal=Combustion and Flame |date=2015 |volume=162 |issue=1 |pages=115–128 |doi=10.1016/j.combustflame.2014.07.001 |bibcode=2015CoFl..162..115T |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0010218014001965 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> underscoring the influence of pressure on the flame front [[curvature]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Emadi |first1=Majid |last2=Karkow |first2=Douglas |last3=Salameh |first3=Taleb |last4=Gohil |first4=Ameet |last5=Ratner |first5=Albert |title=Flame structure changes resulting from hydrogen-enrichment and pressurization for low-swirl premixed methane–air flames |journal=International Journal of Hydrogen Energy |date=2012 |volume=37 |issue=13 |pages=10397–10404 |doi=10.1016/j.ijhydene.2012.04.017 |bibcode=2012IJHE...3710397E |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0360319912008713 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> Moreover, he documented that laser-based techniques reveal plasma and [[electrohydrodynamic]] process insights.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Zigan |first1=Lars |title=Electric Fields in Energy and Process Engineering |journal=Energies |date=2018 |volume=11 |issue=9 |pages=2246 |doi=10.3390/en11092246 |doi-access=free |language=en }}</ref>

Together with Pfadler and Beyrau, Leipertz worked on conditioned [[particle image velocimetry]] (CPIV)<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wang |first1=Xiaoyang |last2=Liu |first2=Kunpeng |last3=Fu |first3=Chen |last4=Yu |first4=Juan |last5=Gao |first5=Yi |title=Investigation of the applicability of conditioned particle image velocimetry under conditions close to lean blow-off |journal=Experiments in Fluids |date=2023 |volume=64 |issue=6 |pages=118 |doi=10.1007/s00348-023-03657-0 |bibcode=2023ExFl...64..118W |language=en |doi-access=free }}</ref> and carried out a comparison between the flame edge extracted from OH-PLIF and [[Mie scattering]] images. In line with this, they implemented a flame front detection method to locate the flame front location in a particle image velocimetry (PIV) measurement.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Zheng |first1=Yutao |last2=Weller |first2=Lee |last3=Hochgreb |first3=Simone |title=Instantaneous flame front identification by Mie scattering vs. OH PLIF in low turbulence Bunsen flame |journal=Experiments in Fluids |date=2022 |volume=63 |issue=5 |pages=79 |doi=10.1007/s00348-022-03423-8 |bibcode=2022ExFl...63...79Z |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-022-03423-8 }}</ref> He employed PIV and Planar [[Filtered Rayleigh scattering]] thermometry (FRS) to determine [[velocity]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Zheng |first1=Yutao |last2=Weller |first2=Lee |last3=Hochgreb |first3=Simone |title=Experimentally Closing the Balance of Progress of Reaction in Premixed Turbulent Combustion in the Thin Flame Regime |journal=Flow, Turbulence and Combustion |date=2024 |volume=112 |issue=4 |pages=1215–1245 |doi=10.1007/s10494-024-00538-2 |bibcode=2024FTC...112.1215Z |language=en|doi-access=free }}</ref>

Leipertz collaborated with Badock and others on a study to investigate the internal flow for the diesel [[injector]] nozzles under 1.5 MPa pressure, documenting no [[cavitation]] films or bubbles inside the nozzle holes.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Dumouchel |first1=Christophe |title=On the experimental investigation on primary atomization of liquid streams |journal=Experiments in Fluids |date=2008 |volume=45 |issue=3 |pages=371–422 |doi=10.1007/s00348-008-0526-0 |bibcode=2008ExFl...45..371D |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00348-008-0526-0 |language=en |url-access=subscription }}</ref> He studied the [[laser-induced incandescence]] (LII) tool to assess the distribution of soot particle size<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Liu |first1=Fengshan |last2=Stagg |first2=Barry J. |last3=Snelling |first3=David R. |last4=Smallwood |first4=Gregory J. |title=Effects of primary soot particle size distribution on the temperature of soot particles heated by a nanosecond pulsed laser in an atmospheric laminar diffusion flame |journal=International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer |date=2006 |volume=49 |issue=3 |pages=777–788 |doi=10.1016/j.ijheatmasstransfer.2005.07.041 |bibcode=2006IJHMT..49..777L |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0017931005005272|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and also established LII as a tool for the production of carbon black.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Geigle |first1=K. P. |last2=Zerbs |first2=J. |last3=Hadef |first3=R. |last4=Guin |first4=C. |date=2019 |title=Laser induced incandescence for soot measurements in an aero-engine combustor at pressures up to 20 bar |journal=Applied Physics B |volume=125 |issue=6 |page=96 |doi=10.1007/s00340-019-7211-2 |bibcode=2019ApPhB.125...96G }}</ref> Furthermore, he carried out a research study to assess the soot temperature, demonstrating how the [[vaporization]] of soot causes a sudden change in the temperature of soot particles within 100 ns of laser pulse irradiance, and how conduction loss controls the temperature decay rates.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Oh |first1=Kwang Chul |last2=Shin |first2=Hyun Dong |title=The effect of oxygen and carbon dioxide concentration on soot formation in non-premixed flames |journal=Fuel |date=2006 |volume=85 |issue=5 |pages=615–624 |doi=10.1016/j.fuel.2005.08.018 |bibcode=2006Fuel...85..615O |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S001623610500284X |url-access=subscription }}</ref>

Leipertz employed inelastic and elastic light scattering methods to investigate how the concentration of the solute affected the supercritical antisolvent (SAS) process,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=De Marco |first1=I. |last2=Knauer |first2=O. |last3=Cice |first3=F. |last4=Braeuer |first4=A. |last5=Reverchon |first5=E. |title=Interactions of phase equilibria, jet fluid dynamics and mass transfer during supercritical antisolvent micronization: The influence of solvents |journal=Chemical Engineering Journal |date=2012 |volume=203 |pages=71–80 |doi=10.1016/j.cej.2012.06.129 |bibcode=2012ChEnJ.203...71D |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1385894712008595 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> documenting the solute's saturation solubility in solvent/antisolvent mixtures as an indirect differentiation measure for distinguishing between crystallizing and amorphous precipitating.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Guijin |first1=Liu |last2=Junjian |first2=Li |last3=Shiming |first3=Deng |title=Applications of Supercritical Anti-Solvent Process in Preparation of Solid Multicomponent Systems |journal=Pharmaceutics |date=2021 |volume=13 |issue=4 |page=475 |doi=10.3390/pharmaceutics13040475 |pmid=33915815 |pmc=8067079 |doi-access=free }}</ref> He highlighted that local information about the combustion zone, spatial droplet distribution, temperature in the flame, and [[nucleation]] zone can be acquired by employing 2D-[[chemiluminescence]] imaging, CARS (coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy), and laser-sheet-based Mie scattering imaging.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://search.worldcat.org/title/908192085|title=Flame spray technology: method for production of nanopowders|website=WorldCat|access-date=September 2, 2025}}</ref>

Throughout his research career, Leipertz also collaborated with other scientists on various themes such as laser-induced gratings (LIG) for measurements in a propane mixture,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Williams |first1=Ben |last2=Edwards |first2=Megan |last3=Stone |first3=Richard |last4=Williams |first4=John |last5=Ewart |first5=Paul |title=High precision in-cylinder gas thermometry using Laser Induced Gratings: Quantitative measurement of evaporative cooling with gasoline/alcohol blends in a GDI optical engine |journal=Combustion and Flame |date=2014 |volume=161 |issue=1 |pages=270–279 |doi=10.1016/j.combustflame.2013.07.018 |bibcode=2014CoFl..161..270W |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0010218013002885|url-access=subscription }}</ref> laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) for determining gas temperature,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Driscoll |first1=James F. |last2=Chen |first2=Jacqueline H. |last3=Skiba |first3=Aaron W. |last4=Carter |first4=Campbell D. |last5=Hawkes |first5=Evatt R. |last6=Wang |first6=Haiou |title=Premixed flames subjected to extreme turbulence: Some questions and recent answers |journal=Progress in Energy and Combustion Science |date=2020 |volume=76 |article-number=100802 |doi=10.1016/j.pecs.2019.100802 |bibcode=2020PECS...7600802D |osti=1572114 |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S036012851930036X }}</ref> and rotational coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (RCARS).<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Lockett |first1=R. D. |last2=Ball |first2=D. |last3=Robertson |first3=G. N. |title=Experimental cross-correlation nitrogen Q-branch CARS thermometry in a spark ignition engine |journal=Optics and Lasers in Engineering |date=2013 |volume=51 |issue=7 |pages=929–943 |doi=10.1016/j.optlaseng.2013.02.010 |bibcode=2013OptLE..51..929L |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0143816613000730 |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
